newsitem.title: USA: Washington opens newest subway station.
newsitem.headline: Washington opens newest subway station.

text.p: The Transportation Department, opening the newest station in Washington's sprawling subway system, announced Sunday $217 million in grants to help complete the remaining 13.5 miles of the system.
The Franconia-Springfield station was opened in northern Virginia, leaving three segments yet to be completed on the system.
The Clinton administration is "committed to funding the remaining miles of the system," said Federal Transit Administrator Gordon Linton, who cut the ribbon opening the new station.
The rail system will serve 103 miles throughout southern Maryland, northern Virginia and the District of Columbia, when completed in 2001.
